title: Complete biodiverse lignocellulosic biomass fractionation process using the green solvent γ-valerolactone
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00600G, Paper
Open Access

Moritz Schweiger, Thomas Lang, Eva Müller, Vojtěch Jeřábek, Jan Heyda, Martin Klajmon, Didier Touraud, Magdalena Bendová, Karel Řehák, Werner Kunz
This work shows a mild biomass fractionation process using the green solvent γ-valerolactone. The process produces the biopolymers lignin, hemicellulose and cellulose in high yields and purities from biodiverse starting materials.
